meta.name: affiliate-blog-builder
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles, product reviews, comparison posts, listicles, and how-to guides. Triggers on: "write a blog post about", "review of [product]", "best [category] article", "comparison blog", "affiliate blog", "SEO article", "write a review", "product roundup", "blog content for affiliate", "how to use [product] blog post", "listicle about [category]", "[product] vs [product] blog", "content for my affiliate site".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动撰写SEO优化的联盟营销博客文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营联盟营销网站，需要大量SEO优化的产品文章。
copy.tagline_en: Write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an affiliate site and need SEO-optimized product articles at scale.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的要求撰写SEO优化的联盟博客文章，包括产品评测、对比、列表和教程，并自动添加关键词、表格、FAQ和推广链接。
howto.when: 当你提到“写一篇关于…的博客”、“评测某产品”、“最佳…文章”、“对比某产品和某产品”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 写一篇关于HeyGen的详细评测文章。
say.note: Claude 会自动收集信息并生成评测。

say.text: 写一篇最佳AI视频工具的列表文章。
say.note: Claude 会搜索热门工具并生成列表。
Claude 会生成对比分析文章。

howto.what_en: Claude will write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles (reviews, comparisons, listicles, how-tos) with keywords, tables, FAQ, and CTAs. Outputs ready-to-publish markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "write a blog post about", "review of [product]", "best [category] article", "comparison blog", etc.

say_en.text: Write a detailed review of HeyGen.
say_en.note: Claude auto-researches and generates the review.

say_en.text: Write a listicle about the best AI video tools.
say_en.note: Claude searches for top tools and writes the list.
